name: House Sparrow
desc: House Sparrow (Passer domesticus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 43 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The house sparrow is a bird of the sparrow family Passeridae, found in most parts of the world. It is a small bird that has a typical length of 16 cm (6.3 in) and a mass of 24–39.5 g (0.85–1.39 oz).
